name: goldilocks
description: A lean Superpowers-compatible workflow suite with dynamic process depth and constant quality standards.

interface.longDescription: Provides thirteen familiar workflow entry skills plus a Goldilocks router backed by six shared progressive-disclosure engines, adaptive continuity, parallel-first execution routing, and task-specific model value selection. It preserves full quality while delegating eligible implementation and tests to efficient workers and keeping Lead review and integration.
defaultPrompt: Use the smallest workflow that preserves full quality.
Plan and execute this without unnecessary process overhead.
Replace a Superpowers workflow with the equivalent Goldilocks entry.
